faq_heading: Coquitlam houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Coquitlam house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 67 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $2,160,000, with the middle half between $1,863,000 and $2,560,000. Every Coquitlam detached house had a median of $1,615,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Coquitlam?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 67 Coquitlam houses sold with a legal suite and 114 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,617,500.

faq.q: How many units can a Coquitlam lot hold?
faq.a: Up to 3 on a lot of 280 square metres or less and up to 4 on a lot over 280 and under 4,050 square metres. There is no 6-unit tier in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What is Coquitlam’s 2026 property tax rate?
faq.a: $2.2756 per $1,000 of assessed value for the municipality, and $3.8520 per $1,000 with the other taxing authorities included.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Burke Mountain had 25 legal-suite sales, Central Coquitlam 12 and Westwood Plateau 7 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Coquitlam houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 26 days at a median, closing at 96.3% of list, with 9% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Coquitlam that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Central Coquitlam (89), Burke Mountain (57), Westwood Plateau (55), Coquitlam West (35) and New Horizons (23). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 457 detached houses that closed in Coquitlam between November 1 and August 31, 181 (40%) had a suite: 67 legal and 114 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $2,160,000, 34% more than the $1,615,000 median for every Coquitlam house.

blocks.text: Coquitlam suite rules

Coquitlam’s zoning bylaw is No. 3000, and Council adopted its small-scale multi-unit changes on June 9, 2025. A lot of 280 square metres or less can have up to 3 units, and one over 280 and under 4,050 square metres up to 4. There is no 6-unit tier, because the City says no Coquitlam bus stop meets the provincial frequent-service test.

Low-density lots sit mostly in R-1, R-2, R-3 or R-4, and each zone sets a minimum lot size for added units, from 465 square metres in R-2 to 930 square metres in R-4. A suite is one of the forms allowed, next to carriage houses, laneway homes, garden cottages, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes.

A lot that is not connected to municipal water or sewer falls outside the small-scale rules. If there is a creek on or beside the lot, a steep slope, or a house built before 1945, speak to the City’s Development Services before you plan around a suite.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Coquitlam was $1,584,400 in September 2026, 6.6% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Costs of a Coquitlam house with a suite

Coquitlam’s 2026 municipal residential rate is $2.2756 per $1,000 of assessed value, or $3.8520 together with the other taxing authorities. Taxes were due July 2, 2026, and the city is inside the Speculation and Vacancy Tax area.
Before you offer on a Coquitlam house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Coquitlam permit and final inspection for the suite. 114 of the 181 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Check for a creek, a steep slope or a pre-1945 house before you buy for the suite. A Watercourse Protection Development Permit applies within 30 metres of the top of bank.
Count the units. Coquitlam allows up to 3 on a lot of 280 square metres or less and up to 4 on a larger one, and each zone sets its own minimum lot size for added units.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 26 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,617,500 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $2,160,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
